entries.key: We count calls, not people: no addresses, no ids, nothing about anyone; only these totals are kept.

judge.reason: Perfectly natural, keeps meaning and tone.

entries.key: A conversation lasts %{call} minutes. When time is up, it continues for another %{extension} minutes only if both people choose to, up to %{max} minutes in all. You can leave at any time.
